d: Much to her demise, a woman shares a party line with two nosy neighbors.
Judgment day approaches for an innocent man (Brian Keith) who is facing the gas chamber for murder. With James Westerfield.
The arrival of a new governess (Hermione Gingold) at the Wellington household has surprising results. With Elspeth March.
A writer arrives in a small town to investigate the circumstances of a bank robbery in which the money was never found.
Two kidnappers come upon a tanker in the middle of the desert and decide to make their escape in it. With Burt Reynolds and James Bell.
A man (Robert Horton) schemes with a young woman (Anne Francis) to get rid of his wealthy wife (Vivienne Segal).
An escaped convict (Clu Gulager) visits a spinster (Katherine Squire) and her niece seeking his pen pal.
A woman and her lover (Sarah Marshall, Peter Walker) plot her husband's (Richard Gaines) demise, but their plans go awry because of her ineptitude.
A man (Arthur Hill) makes a serious mistake when he tries to do the right thing. With R.G. Armstrong and Rod Cameron.
A woman (Madeleine Sherwood) plots her husband's (James Best) death when she discovers he has been unfaithful. With Diana Van Der Vlis and Joe Flynn.
A man confides in his doctor about his unusual experience involving time travel.
A woman (Betty Field) steps in to help a desperate man (Walter Matthau) save his company from bankruptcy.
A ceramics teacher (Sydney Pollack) at a summer camp finds a boy (Barry Gordon) with an unusual gift for sculpting. With Frank Maxwell.
